_comment: Hand-written. pnpm wowhead-list-gaps:check (scripts/check_wowhead_list_gaps.py, tickets 678 and 173) fails when an item a spec's Wowhead list names is absent from that spec's universe, or is present with first source kind unknown, unless a row here names that (spec, itemId) at that phase.

The check also fails on a row that is no longer a gap (STALE GAP), so this file only shrinks: remove a row when its gap is fixed, and never add one to make the check pass without a ticket that owns the gap.

Reasons were assigned per id by the investigation in .scratch/agent-reports/2026-10-17-general-task-gates-678-679-683.md section A (gitignored), not classified by code. Ticket 17 owns the five-man and heroic membership rows; ticket 676 (part P4) owns the unknownSource rows and the missing source inputs.
phases lists every phase 2-5 at which the item is a gap; an item absent at some phases and unknown at others would need two rows (there are none).

unreadLists names each list file whose name states no phase, so no phase reads it; the check fails on any other such file (UNPLACED LIST) and on a row here that a phase reads or whose file is gone (STALE UNREAD).

unreadLists.reason: The pre-raid guide is BiS before raiding, and no universe (phases 2-5) has ever read it for membership; whether p5 should read it is ticket 676's open owner question. The builder's cross-spec index does read its badge, PvP and world rows, since those describe the item.

reasons.notInDb: The item id is not in vendor/wowsims/db.json, so the builder cannot add it.
reasons.notD7: The item is in db.json but is not D7-eligible for this spec, so no membership route considers it.
reasons.noSource: D7-eligible, but no input gives it a source; the report counts it in excludedNoSource.
reasons.stubOnly: The sim implements its effect only as a TODO stub (stubOnlyItemIds), so the builder leaves it out.
reasons.sourcedNoRoute: The item has a db.json source, but no membership route admits it; no report count records it.
reasons.unknownSource: The item is in the universe, but its first source is kind unknown: no source the builder keeps is named for it (ticket 676 section Q-676-source measured, 'Why own-spec list rows stay unknown').
